selected_proposals.selection_rationale: Strongest direct exploit of GEN015-M01: per-channel damped vector-norm gate targets vector-readout scale while preserving the successful normalized readout direction.
Tiny scalar low-start gate provides a conservative exploit/control-like variant of vector damping with low implementation risk.
Residual vector-readout blend tests the same exploit family with a smoother interpolation from the current frontier unit.
Gated scalar update is the higher-phase jump most aligned with the available vector-readout damping evidence.
Low-rank vector norm adapter is a bounded jump that increases readout flexibility without changing benchmark semantics.
Fixed quarter-strength vector readout provides the required backward-simplify axis and isolates whether learned gating is necessary.
Exact source replicate anchors generation_015 variance against generation_014/proposal_009.
Scalar-vector cross readout is a mechanism-diversity wildcard that still stays close to the vector-readout evidence thread.

omitted_proposals.reason: Diagnosis-driven energy/force balance is useful but weaker evidence than the selected GEN015-M01-aligned jump proposals.
Vector-norm dropout is a weak-evidence wildcard and lower priority than scalar-vector cross readout for the eight-unit budget.
